head: gallery_grade
rule: the winning arm must beat BOTH incumbents on BOTH statistics at EVERY seed, strictly, on the held-out lineages. Any one of those failing is a FAIL for the band — there is no partial credit and no best-of

population.is: the stopping slice — within-store held out, optimistic by one early stop, and drawn from a store that is not eval-eligible. This bar says which of three quantities orders these rows best and nothing about any other rows

does_not_gate: the arm ranking, the epoch, or anything about the pool. Adoption is a separate act and this bar does not authorize one
